experiment: Statistical reliability of E13 quantized ProtoWords test results

bootstrap.method: Paired nonparametric bootstrap over test-image indices

significance_test.method: Exact two-sided McNemar test on paired correctness indicators
significance_test.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm step-down correction across four comparisons

interpretation_note: Confidence intervals describe paired test-set accuracy differences under image resampling. McNemar tests compare discordant predictions. These analyses do not replace evaluation across multiple independently trained models or multiple data splits.
